text:
Sam_sales: Quick sync — NovaBank POC surfaced three enterprise auth asks: SAML assertion transforms, SCIM group provisioning (delta sync), and RBAC scoping per domain. They also want strict domain-locking for tenant claims and auditor-friendly logs. Need to scope POC, timeline, and pricing. Any quick wins?
Marie_se: Quick q's — IdP preferences? SP vs IdP initiated? Which IdPs? How large is the initial sync?
Alex_sales: They have Okta + Azure AD. Org size ~5k users; POC subset ~250 users, ~12 groups. They want full initial + delta thereafter.
Priya_security: Security checklist: signed assertions, audience & recipient validation, cert rotation for IdP metadata, confirm NameID format. For SCIM: TLS mandatory; for Private we'll support mTLS. We need attribute hashing policy for PII in logs.
Marie_se: SCIM rate limits are 60 req/min/org by default. For a 5k initial sync recommend bulk CSV + enable delta SCIM afterwards or schedule throttled runs off-hours. Bulk import available for POC to avoid rate limiting.
Ian_product: Hosted = fastest onboard. Dedicated/Private recommended for strict tenant isolation and domain-locking. Domain verification requires DNS TXT proof; for Private, customer runs verifier locally. That affects timeline & cost.
Sam_sales: Pricing question — are SAML attribute transforms and SCIM group filtering included in POC SE time or billed as eng work?
Marie_se: Basic attribute mapping (up to ~4h) included in SE support. Custom transform/new mapping engine is eng work (2–3 days). Group scoping/filtering usually config only.
Priya_security: RBAC supports role templates + resource tags. Need to confirm if they want delegated admin per domain or cross-tenant roles. Have them fill SSO section of security questionnaire; I'll attach the SAML checklist.
Sam_sales: Draft POC plan: 1) Domain proofing + IdP metadata exchange, 2) Bulk user import + SCIM delta, 3) SAML assertion test matrix, 4) RBAC template mapping + delegated admin test, 5) Load/spike tests for token issuance & provisioning (target 100 rps). Timeline: 2 weeks. Thoughts?
Marie_se: Good plan. For spike tests we need a test Okta tenant or SAML test IdP and a user dataset. I'll prep a runbook + sample curl for bulk import.
Ian_product: For spike testing recommend Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency. On hosted we can enable temporary burst but results could be noisy. Share Dedicated trial pricing.
Marie_se: I'll draft quote: POC SE support (8h), optional eng time for custom transforms, Dedicated trial pricing for 2 weeks.
Sam_sales: Priya — can you share the SAML checklist snippet to send to customer? Marie — can you add runbook + mapping example? I'll schedule kickoff for Tue.
Priya_security: SAML checklist excerpt: - signed assertions required - audience & recipient matching - cert rollover plan - NameID format + persistence - exact SAML attribute names required. DMing full security questionnaire. :white_check_mark:
Marie_se: Runbook snippet:
```bash
# bulk SCIM import
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/novabank/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'file=@users.csv'
```
Sample mapping notes: `user.email -> principal`, `user.firstName/lastName -> displayName`, `roles -> groups`. For SAML example: `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User.externalId -> idp:employeeNumber`.
Sam_sales: :thumbsup: I'll send the invite and kickoff agenda. Flag legal/DSA blockers now (DPA, audit logs).
Marie_se: Will attach quote draft and runbook.
Priya_security: I'll confirm DPA/legal checklist and attach short security note for legal.
Sam_sales: Thanks all — ping here if any blockers pop up (SAML quirks, legal delays, domain issues).
